Messages.Author: Alfred Behrends
Messages.Body:
Some questions about moving retainers and raptors:

(A) Ox (ANI) recruits a Raptor.
The Raptor is moved to Dani (ani) by Heidelberg Castle.
Does the Raptor 'stay in superior mode' ?

(B) Dani (ani) uses Shepherd's Innocence to take control of
Ox' Raptor.
Is the Raptor now in 'inferior mode' ?

(C) Blaise (ANI; CEL) has a Raptor on her.
She's in combat with another minion, whose Meth reduces
his hand size by one. After combat ends Blaise plays Psyche.
Does the opposing Meth replace his hand and then discards
again another card to reduce his handsize?

(D) Blaise (ANI) with a Raptor started combat with another minion.
After combat is over Ox (ANI, OBF) wants to use Hidden Lurker
to get in combat.
Is there an opportunity to tap Heidelberg Castle betweeen these
combats to move the Raptor to Ox before he plays Hidden Lurker
or does the combat from Hidden Lurker still count as 'during the action'?

(E) If there is an opportunity in (D): Would the opposing Meth redraw and
re-discard ?

(F) If Ox in (D) already has a Raptor: Would the opposing Meth
redraw and re-discard ?

Alf Behrends
Prince of Braunschweig
Germany

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Alfred Behrends" <AlfBe...@t-online.de> a écrit dans le message news:
9pu51m$kfpeb$2...@ID-46545.news.dfncis.de...

> Some questions about moving retainers and raptors:
>
> (A) Ox (ANI) recruits a Raptor.
> The Raptor is moved to Dani (ani) by Heidelberg Castle.
> Does the Raptor 'stay in superior mode' ?

Yes. The raptor was recruited (employed) by a vamp with superior animalism,
so the superior card text applies.

> (B) Dani (ani) uses Shepherd's Innocence to take control of
> Ox' Raptor.
> Is the Raptor now in 'inferior mode' ?

No. It's still a super annoyance, uber-raptor =)

> (C) Blaise (ANI; CEL) has a Raptor on her.
> She's in combat with another minion, whose Meth reduces
> his hand size by one. After combat ends Blaise plays Psyche.
> Does the opposing Meth replace his hand and then discards
> again another card to reduce his handsize?

Yes.

> (D) Blaise (ANI) with a Raptor started combat with another minion.
> After combat is over Ox (ANI, OBF) wants to use Hidden Lurker
> to get in combat.
> Is there an opportunity to tap Heidelberg Castle betweeen these
> combats to move the Raptor to Ox before he plays Hidden Lurker
> or does the combat from Hidden Lurker still count as 'during the action'?

No. It's still part of an action (hidden lurker is an action modifier) and
you can't tap heidelberg during actions.

> (E) If there is an opportunity in (D): Would the opposing Meth redraw and
> re-discard ?

If both vampires (Blaise and ox) had raptors, Yes, the meth would have to
discard and redraw after combat, then discard for the hidden lurker
triggered combat.

> (F) If Ox in (D) already has a Raptor: Would the opposing Meth
> redraw and re-discard ?

Yes =)

Messages.Author: JC
Messages.Body:
[I don't claim to know these answers for sure. I just hope to help out
until you get an official answer.]

"Alfred Behrends" <AlfBe...@t-online.de> wrote in message news:<9pu51m$kfpeb$2...@ID-46545.news.dfncis.de>...

> Some questions about moving retainers and raptors:
>
> (A) Ox (ANI) recruits a Raptor.
> The Raptor is moved to Dani (ani) by Heidelberg Castle.
> Does the Raptor 'stay in superior mode' ?

I think so. For the same reasons than when Dani recruits a raptor and
then gets superior Animalism, the Raptor stays at inferior. This is
part of the "you'd have to take notes to keep track of everything
problem" ... A card keeps the "mode" it had when it came into play.

> (B) Dani (ani) uses Shepherd's Innocence to take control of
> Ox' Raptor.
> Is the Raptor now in 'inferior mode' ?

I think not, for the same reasons.

> (C) Blaise (ANI; CEL) has a Raptor on her.
> She's in combat with another minion, whose Meth reduces
> his hand size by one. After combat ends Blaise plays Psyche.
> Does the opposing Meth replace his hand and then discards
> again another card to reduce his handsize?

I think so, because it is a different combat.

> (D) Blaise (ANI) with a Raptor started combat with another minion.
> After combat is over Ox (ANI, OBF) wants to use Hidden Lurker
> to get in combat.
> Is there an opportunity to tap Heidelberg Castle betweeen these
> combats to move the Raptor to Ox before he plays Hidden Lurker
> or does the combat from Hidden Lurker still count as 'during the action'?

Since HL is an action modifier, I don't think you can use the HC.

> (E) If there is an opportunity in (D): Would the opposing Meth redraw and
> re-discard ?
>
> (F) If Ox in (D) already has a Raptor: Would the opposing Meth
> redraw and re-discard ?

I think so, because it is a different combat (same thing as Psyche!).

JC

>

> so the superior card text applies.

Correct. The requirements of a card are only checked when the card
is played (cf. Hunting Grounds, etc.). Once in play, the attributes
of a card do not change (except as noted in the rules or on card text).

Correct.
